    <id>http://arxiv.org/abs/math/9909153v1</id>
    <title>Riemann Hypothesis</title>
    <updated>1999-09-25T04:05:53Z</updated>
    <link href="https://arxiv.org/abs/math/9909153v1" rel="alternate" type="text/html"/>
    <link href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/9909153v1" rel="related" type="application/pdf" title="pdf"/>
    <summary>  Through an equivalent condition on the Farey series set forth by Franel and Landau, we prove Riemann Hypothesis for the Riemann zeta-function and the Dirichlet L-function.</summary>

    </author>
  </entry>

    <summary>This work is dedicated to the promotion of the results Hadamard, Landau E., Walvis A., Estarmann T and Paul R. Chernoff for pseudo zeta functions. The properties of zeta functions are studied, these properties can lead to new regularities of zeta functions.</summary>
